scope: Non-Skyranger airborne blocking examples. Selected client-table records retained in existing third-party mirrors, cross-checked with gameplay documentation; not freshly extracted installed bundles or a full census.

records.name: 晴空湍流
records.descriptionExcerpt: 置于其中的单位可以在浮空时阻挡空中敌人
records.mechanism: The stage description assigns this ability to units on the levitatable zone while it is floating; it is not restricted to the Skyranger subclass.

records.name: 风絮
records.description: 恢复友方单位生命，并且可以<$ba.liftoff>起飞</>
records.limit: Table identity, trait and base block count are verified here. The Watchman-specific takeoff implementation was not traced; its airborne blocking behavior is cross-checked against gameplay documentation.

limits: The levitatable-zone record is not a complete trace from its specific prefab to Tile.charBlockMotionMode.
A generic dynamic-height code path, ignoreBlockMode, visually flying, or attacking aerial targets alone is not counted as another actual content example.
Base blockCnt does not include talents or runtime modifiers.
